lines.text: Want you to, not want that!
Many learners say: I want that you come early.
Better: I want you to come early.
After want, use the person and to.
Me to! She wants me to help her.

data.wrong: I want that you come early.
data.right: I want you to come early.
data.why: After want, use the person and to.

native.tip: हिंदी में “मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम आओ” का “कि” अंग्रेज़ी में that बन जाता है; want के बाद “व्यक्ति + to” आता है।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “I want that you come early.” 😅 सही रूप है “I want you to come early.” क्योंकि want के बाद व्यक्ति और to आता है। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “me to”। अब इसी तरह अपना एक वाक्य लिखिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners use that after want, but English uses the person and to.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I want that you come early.” 😅 The right way is “I want you to come early.” This is right because want takes the person and to. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
